# TrustMyLab — Comprehensive Platform Documentation & Clinical Architecture
> https://trustmylab.in

## 1. Overview
TrustMyLab is an enterprise-grade multi-tenant diagnostic laboratory information management system (LIMS) engineered for clinical pathology laboratories, imaging centers, and diagnostic franchises across India, GCC, and global markets.

## 2. Technical Architecture & Security Standards
- **Data Isolation**: Strict multi-tenant row-level and ORM filtering guaranteeing zero cross-tenant leakage between competing diagnostic centers.
- **Security Compliance**: HIPAA and ISO 15189 compliance standards. TLS 1.3 in-transit encryption and AES-256 rest encryption.
- **Cryptographic Reports**: Every finalized PDF report includes an HMAC SHA-256 tamper-proof cryptographic digest and digital signature.
- **Verification Portal**: Independent public verification endpoint (`/verify/:token`) allowing patients and healthcare providers to verify authenticity online.

## 3. Pathology & Radiology Modules
- **Phlebotomy Worklist**: Real-time sample collection tracking, barcode tracking, draw timestamps, and rejection handling.
- **Results Entry & Auto-Calculation**: Automated reference flag evaluations for Complete Blood Count (CBC), Liver Function Tests (LFT), Kidney Function Tests (KFT), Urine Analysis, and specialized hormone panels.
- **Medical Imaging & Templates**: Ultrasound (USG), X-Ray, CT, and MRI clinical reporting templates with predefined normal findings and organ-specific presets.
- **Signatory Credentials**: Multi-signatory workflow allowing primary and secondary pathologists to attach verified digital signatures and medical council registration numbers.

## 4. Financial & Commercial Management
- **Doctor Commissions**: Comprehensive tracking of referral incentives by percentage or flat amount per test, with settlement tracking and statement printing.
- **Invoicing & Receipts**: Instant thermal 80mm/58mm POS receipt generation, GST tax invoice generation, and partial payment management.
- **Daily Expense Log**: Petty cash and clinic expense management categorized by consumables, staff expenses, reagents, and maintenance.

## 5. Subscription Plans
- **Starter Plan**: Designed for solo pathology clinics and collection centers (Up to 1,500 tests/month, standard reports, barcode tracking).
- **Professional Plan**: Designed for growing diagnostic centers (Up to 5,000 tests/month, doctor commissions, WhatsApp dispatch, custom letterheads).
- **Enterprise Plan**: Designed for diagnostic chains and hospital networks (Unlimited tests, multi-branch routing, custom SLA, dedicated support).

## 6. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
- **Q: How fast can our laboratory get started with TrustMyLab?**
  A: You can launch your lab account in less than 5 minutes! Pre-configured test catalogs and built-in PDF report templates allow immediate patient booking.
- **Q: Is patient health data secure?**
  A: Yes. All data is isolated at the ORM layer, encrypted with TLS 1.3/AES-256, and reports feature cryptographic HMAC SHA-256 signatures.
- **Q: Can we customize report templates with our lab logo and doctor signatures?**
  A: Yes. Upload custom letterhead backgrounds, digital doctor signatures, and brand accent colors.
